title: EVERY MACHINE DIES WITH ITS OWN NOISE
why: His order of 2026-10-12: all robots should have a distinct destruction noise for when they are killed. A machine died in silence: the round that killed it made the same metal tick as any other hit, and a machine killed by a charge, a Howler shell or another machine made no sound at all. Now every kind has its own: the Sentry servo seizes with an electrical pop and tinkling debris, the Crawler legs skitter out into a light crunch, the Crier alarm wails down and is cut by a crackle, the Listener dish whine climbs and snaps off, the Howler growl chokes into a burst, the Bulwark armour plates clang down, the Pillbox turret detonates and its shell rings, the Warden groans and collapses, and the Overseer goes out in a long layered blast with a falling tone and a rain of debris, the biggest sound in the game. Each is placed where it died (left, right, far and behind walls), small machines under a gunshot and big ones near it. Sound only: nothing in the raid changes.
now: Every machine now dies with its own noise, from the Crawler crunch to the Overseer blast.
